workflow: Reviewed native seed, build_sprite_edit_canvas.py, one whole-sheet edit per animation asset, shared body scale and reviewed foot/pelvis anchors; alpha threshold and connected silhouettes, nearest-neighbour normalization without redrawing.

sources.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production pixel-art fighter seed for TIDE FIGHTERS, a side-view 2D fighting game.
Input image 1 is the authoritative full-body Mizuki character identity and requested original black-stocking outfit. Input image 2 is an existing shipped Shiori pixel fighter, STYLE and ADULT BODY PROPORTION reference only; do not borrow Shiori clothes or face.
Create ONE full-body Mizuki female fighter, standing in a relaxed martial-arts ready stance facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view, feet apart, front fist lifted and rear hand guarding, both feet fully visible. Faithfully retain pale blonde curly twin tails, large black bows crossed by white ribbons, small white bow clips, purple/pink eyes, high black blouse collar, cropped black jacket with fine gold chains and small rabbit brooch, round buckle belt, black pleated skirt, charcoal semi-sheer black stockings with the small upper-thigh buckle strap, and black ankle boots with blue-gray folded cuffs. Keep skirt down, normal combat presentation. No hat, no braids, no swimsuit.
Match the shipped fighter's detailed crisp pixel clusters, restrained 16-bit fighting-game shading, dark outline and near-realistic adult proportions (about 7 heads tall, small readable face, long athletic legs). The entire upright body should read clearly at about184 native pixels tall. Leave generous transparent space around the full silhouette. No chibi, no big head, no painterly smoothing, no extra character, no floor, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no effects, no watermark. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. One coherent standing fighter sprite suitable for generating all her animation sheets.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite animation for the 2D fighting game TIDE FIGHTERS.
Reference 1 is a transparent edit canvas with the approved Mizuki seed; reference 2 is the larger version of the exact same character. Preserve her pale blonde curly twin tails, black bows with white crossed ribbon, small white bow clips, purple/pink eyes, black high-collar blouse and cropped jacket with gold chains/rabbit brooch, round belt buckle and black pleated skirt, charcoal BLACK STOCKINGS with buckle strap, and black boots with blue-gray folded cuffs.
Same adult fighter, facing RIGHT in consistent three-quarter SIDE VIEW in every frame. Exactly the same body/head/torso/limb size, palette, face, outfit proportions, crisp native pixel clusters and dark outline across all frames. Near-realistic adult fighting-game proportions, no chibi, no large head, no smooth illustration. Every pose retains long stocking-covered legs and skirt, neutral nonsexual combat presentation.
Replace the empty edit canvas with ONE exactly 4 columns by 4 rows spritesheet: SIXTEEN independent full-body figures, equal square slots,1792x1792 preferred. Keep all standing pose feet on a shared cell baseline.
Row1 frames0-3: relaxed fighting idle, subtle breath, slight hand guard shifts, subtle ponytail bounce, all about the same tall standing height.
Row2 frames4-7: four phases of walk forward RIGHT, different legs/arms on each step, standing torso and head height comparable to idle, feet alternately leading.
Row3 frames8-11: first two frames crouch down and low crouching guard with both boots grounded; final two frames tall standing block guard with forearms crossed then braced, about same standing height as idle.
Row4 frames12-15: jump sequence, toe-off with rear leg extended downward (tall body reference), rising knees, apex with knees bent and hair lifting, landing with knees flexed; torso/head retain the same physical scale.
Generate the entire sheet in ONE edit for strong consistency, with distinct silhouettes and readable changes in action. Each figure complete in its cell, clear 24px transparent gutters; never crop head, hands, hair or boots, no overlapping silhouettes. Keep common upright body scale; a crouch or bent leg should shorten the pose naturally, never enlarge it to fill its cell; wide attacks must not be miniaturized. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no scenery, no floor, no shadows, no particles, no glow, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no watermark.

Replace the empty edit canvas with ONE exactly 4 columns by 6 rows spritesheet: TWENTY-FOUR independent full-body figures, equal slots,1792x2688 preferred. All figures face RIGHT; feet on the same cell baseline for standing attacks. The first five rows are complete four-frame animations STARTUP / FULL EXTENSION ACTIVE / RECOIL / RECOVERY.
Row1 frames0-3: quick standing straight punch; tall ready stance, fist extending to right, pull back, settle in guard.
Row2 frames4-7: standing long front boot kick, knee chamber then leg fully extended horizontally RIGHT while rear boot planted, leg retracts, standing guard. Long leg strike must read clearly.
Row3 frames8-11: low sweep from a crouch, low coil then stocking-covered leg extended along the ground RIGHT, retract, crouch guard. Natural shorter pose, same size torso and head.
Row4 frames12-15: signature LUNAR ARC KICK, low forward lunge with one knee chambered, full advancing diagonal-up-right roundhouse kick with the rear supporting boot on the baseline and skirt trailing, recoil the kicking leg, settle in ready stance. No projectile; physically distinct from the normal horizontal kick.
Row5 frames16-19: RISING MOON KICK, deep coil then rising knee and high upward front boot strike, apex leg bent, land and return to stance. Same character size.
Row6 frames20-23: exactly four distinct reactions: frame20 small standing hit recoil, frame21 stronger leaning-back hurt with boots grounded and hands open; frame22 knocked down, whole body lying sideways on ground facing right with both boots visible; frame23 tall confident victory stance facing right, one fist raised modestly near shoulder and other on hip. Victory is the upright scale reference for this row.
